audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike was 'Nasus completes Sheen or Triforce', and the late spike was 'Full-stack Nasus with Spirit Visage'.
audit.why: No item data exists in the kit files, and the packet already flagged 'Spirit Visage' as a suspect name. The verifiable spikes are in his kit: Siphoning Strike falls from 7.5s to 3.5s and is an auto-attack reset, and Fury of the Sands (120/100/80s) grants bonus health, attack range, armour and magic resist while it runs.
audit.corrected: Both spikes now rest on kit facts instead of item guesses.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] told the player that Nasus converts his hits to true damage. He has none. wants.foe[1] and whys[3] again called Sejuani's resistances 'passive Permafrost resistances' and said Frost stacks 'accumulate passively'.
audit.why: Nothing in Nasus's kit is true damage — Soul Eater is lifesteal, Siphoning Strike is a scaling on-hit strike, Spirit Fire shreds armour, and Fury of the Sands carries the percentHealth flag for its aura. Telling a Sejuani her armour is bypassed makes her build the wrong item. On the Sejuani side: her resistances are Fury of the North / Frost Armor, and Frost stacks come from Winter's Wrath — they do not accumulate on their own. The decisive interaction, mirrored from the Nasus-side audit, is that Frost Armor grants IMMUNITY TO SLOWS, so Wither's movement slow does not stick until Nasus has damaged her out of it.
audit.corrected: True-damage claim removed, correct passive and Frost-stack source used, and the Frost Armor / Wither interaction now stated from Sejuani's side.

notes: Mirror reused from audits/top/nasus__sejuani.json — the level chart already matched inversely so I left it alone, and I restated that file's Frost Armor / Wither finding from Sejuani's side. I inherited its scope limit deliberately: every line I wrote says the SLOW does not stick, never that Wither's attack-speed reduction is blocked. Riot's Fury of the North text says 'immunity to slows' and whether that covers the attack-speed component is not answerable from these files. Worst error found on my side: wants.foe[2] told Sejuani players that Nasus converts his hits to true damage. He has no true damage anywhere in his kit, and that line would push a Sejuani away from buying armour against a champion whose entire threat is physical.
